title: Protein Set Selection: a Horus plugin for multi-objective protein family selection
description:
A Horus plugin that selects a small, expressible, structurally diverse subset of a protein family: ProteinMPNN scoring, MMseqs2 clustering, Rosetta relax, BioEmu ensemble sampling, Pareto ranking and codon optimisation.

Developed at the Barcelona Supercomputing Center for the ROBUSTOO project (deliverable D1.3, WP1), funded by the European Union under Grant Agreement No 101135119.
